title: Discovery Agent pilot on completed ClearFront phase
description: Execute EXP-0003 using the operator-provided seven-pass, non-forcing Discovery Agent method. A new visible Codex helper performs proposal-only discovery over the completed ClearFront decomposition phase. Freeze the known-findings set before receiving helper output. Adjudicate each finding as known duplicate, useful refinement, genuinely new useful finding, weak/speculative, or scope drift. Do not implement or automatically promote findings.
acceptance_criteria: Discovery helper runs visibly in wezterm-tab, makes no implementation edits, and may report no findings.
Every reported finding uses exactly one allowed classification and the required evidence/scoring format.
Known-findings truth set is frozen before helper output and covers existing audit, E/I, Sentinel, and operator-raised findings.
Coordinator adjudicates novelty, value, requirement-label accuracy, scope drift, duplicates, rejected ideas, and curation time.
Pilot conclusion recommends adopt, revise, or reject with measured evidence; no finding is automatically promoted or implemented.
